about: Renew a UAE residence permit, linked to an Emirates ID application.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Residence permit renewal. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The passport must be valid for at least 6 months

After a permit expires or is cancelled there is a grace period: 30 days for most people, 60 days with a guarantor or host, 90 days for skilled workers and property owners, 180 days for Golden, Green and Blue residents
documents: Family: water or electricity bill, lease, attested marriage and birth certificates
Work: medical report, employment contract, and the work permit
fees: 50 AED a day for staying after the grace period
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
